description: Name of the S3 bucket this row reports usage for.
The S3 storage class, e.g. Standard, Standard-IA, Glacier. Each class has a different per-GB price.
Average amount of data stored in the bucket during the billing period, in gigabytes.
Number of GET/PUT/LIST API requests made against the bucket during the billing period.
Amount of data transferred out of the bucket to the internet, in gigabytes. Billed separately from storage.
Sum of storage cost, request cost, and data transfer cost for this bucket, in USD.
